codeReview.summary: The rerun clears the prior dashboard and farm-detail locale blockers: `dashboard.hero.*` now exists in `hi.ts`/`mr.ts`, `farmDetails.safeHarvest.inlineTitle` exists in `hi.ts`/`mr.ts`, and the previously hardcoded farm-detail labels now go through `t()` calls. But the new farms-summary localization is still incomplete because the screen now reads `farms.summary.*` keys that were never added to the default English locale.

issues.description: The farms-summary fix is still incomplete in the default locale. `app/(tabs)/farms.tsx:160` now calls `t('farms.summary.count', { count: farms.length })` and `t('farms.summary.area', { value: totalArea })`, but `src/i18n/locales/en.ts:562-577` has no `farms.summary` block at all; only `src/i18n/locales/hi.ts:577-580` and `src/i18n/locales/mr.ts:578-581` define those keys. Because `src/i18n/index.ts:24-25` sets both `lng` and `fallbackLng` to `en`, English users will fall through to missing-key output instead of localized summary text.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The shared UI-worker guidance still conflicts with real fix work. This rerun correctly invoked `ui-worker`, but the task required locale-file edits even though both the mission guidance and the skill tell workers not to change i18n keys / translation files.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `worker-transcripts.jsonl:20` for session `ee6cb54f-5591-425a-aeb6-3d19905a3164` shows both `mission-worker-base` and `ui-worker` were invoked; `.factory/skills/ui-worker/SKILL.md:47` says 'Do NOT modify ... i18n keys'; `AGENTS.md:10` marks `src/i18n/` off-limits; `git show --stat 0941db2` includes `src/i18n/locales/mr.ts`.

summary: Fail: the rerun fixes the prior dashboard/farm-detail locale blockers, but it still ships an incomplete farms-summary localization because `en.ts` lacks `farms.summary.*`, so the default English locale will not render the new summary line correctly.
